metadata.remarks: Data Encryption defines cryptographic requirements to preserve data confidentiality across storage, processing, and transmission. This pattern ensures encryption is applied consistently when required by classification and policy, while delegating key lifecycle and trust establishment to Key Management and PKI.

components.title: Encryption of Data at Rest
components.description: Ensures stored data is protected from unauthorized access through strong cryptographic mechanisms.

props.name: attack-technique

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Encryption prevents disclosure of data accessed from storage.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Cryptographic mechanisms protect data at rest.

components.title: Encryption of Data in Transit

props.name: defense-technique

implemented-requirements.remarks: Transmission confidentiality and integrity are enforced.

components.title: Approved Cryptographic Configuration
